content.text:
This confirms it: commit `6659b98` renamed only the main `YuleApplication.java` package from `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` to `com.github.piotr_rusin.yule`, but left the test class (`YuleApplicationTests.java`) in the old `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` package. Since `@SpringBootTest` without an explicit class searches up the test's own package hierarchy for a `@SpringBootApplication`/`@SpringBootConfiguration` class, after this rename the test package no longer shared an ancestor package with `YuleApplication`, so context loading would fail (`Unable to find a @SpringBootConfiguration`). The fix commit `fdab258` simply moved the test file into the matching `piotr_rusin` package to restore the shared package hierarchy.

I also checked `12c5454` (Jan 14), which re-touched both `YuleApplication.java` (piotr_rusin) and the test file (still piotr/rusin) but did not fix the mismatch either — it just added unrelated content in both files, so it's not where the divergence began; it only perpetuated the already-introduced inconsistency.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 6659b989e0a57d67df00983f53ba391af61f70a6

## Reasoning
(1) I traced the file history of both the old (`piotr/rusin`) and new (`piotr_rusin`) test paths and found the test file was created by the initial commit `dd99776` in package `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule`, matching the main `YuleApplication.java` package at that time. I then checked all main-source commits touching that package and found `6659b98` renamed only `YuleApplication.java`'s package to `com.github.piotr_rusin.yule`.

(2) `6659b98` is a single-file rename/package-declaration change that moved the main application class to `com.github.piotr_rusin.yule` while leaving `YuleApplicationTests.java` (and its directory) in `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule`. This broke the implicit package-hierarchy contract that Spring Boot's `@SpringBootTest` relies on (searching upward from the test's package for a `@SpringBootConfiguration`), since the test package and the application package no longer share a common ancestor.

(3) The fix commit `fdab258` is purely a rename of the test file into `com.github.piotr_rusin.yule`, exactly undoing the divergence created in `6659b98` — strong direct evidence that `6659b98` is where the mismatch (and the resulting bug/test failure) originated. A later commit `12c5454` touched both files again but preserved the same mismatch rather than introducing it, so it is not the root cause.
